evidence_snippets: A pod represents a running process on your cluster. prepaid balance An amount of money available for a prepaid developer to pay in advance for API packages. prepaid developer A developer who pays in advance for the use of an API product.
An Apigee service in the management plane that processes incoming analytics, debug, and deployment status data and makes it available to you through the Apigee hybrid UI or the Apigee APIs .

Application developers - create applications that consume API Proxies. developer category rate plan A rate plan that applies to all developers in a specific category and is available for purchase by all developers in that category. developer rate plan A rate plan that applies to a specific developer and is available for purchase only by that developer.
